subject: SDK environment smoke run — coordination and next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Dev sync: SDK env & auth/routing smoke run — post-call recap

Alex — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our call and the things we committed to follow up on. I want to make sure both teams are aligned before the smoke run we agreed to next week.

What we heard (high-level)
- You want a short, reproducible dev flow that your engineers can run locally (Python + TypeScript samples) to validate auth, routing, and embeddings.
- Security wants SAML metadata + allowed IP ranges; infra team is standardizing on Milvus for vector store.
- Production routing: primary region us-west, fallback to us-east with a smaller model variant for cost/availability.

Action items we (Redwood) will deliver by EOD Thu:
- Python quickstart repo: README + smoke test script (auth via OAuth2 client-credentials, optional SAML mapping) — attachment: redwood-sdk-quickstart-overview.pdf
- TypeScript sample app that demonstrates structured output (function/tool calling) + embeddings call pattern; includes a small reranker example — attachment: sample-app-manifest.md
- A short routing recommendation doc (policy for region/model fallback) and a sample config to drop into your test harness.

Requests for your team (Novus):
- Send SAML metadata XML and the security contact for SSO verification (we need the entityID and ACS URL).
- Confirm allowed egress IP ranges (or if you'll use VPC peering).
- Confirm whether embeddings should be stored in your Milvus cluster or prefer Redwood-managed vector store for the pilot.

Proposed timing
- Smoke run: Tue, May 4 — 60 minute slot for guided run with your devs.
- Pre-read: we will push the quickstart repo and the smoke test checklist 48 hours before the run.

Notes: attachments referenced above are small stubs to guide the team; full repos will be shared via private GitHub link.

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa and Ben to coordinate the delivery.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
https://redwood.com
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novushealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Team <sec-team@novushealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dev sync: SDK env & auth/routing smoke run — post-call recap

Jonas — appreciate the clear recap. Attached the SAML metadata (saml-metadata.xml) and putting our security lead, Priya Shah, on copy (sec-team). A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Embeddings: we are planning to use Milvus in our staging cluster for the pilot. Can your quickstart demonstrate storing embeddings to an external vector store (Milvus) and also include minimal code to swap to Redwood-managed vector store?
2) Routing: we like the primary/fallback idea. Two questions — how granular can routing be (per-route or per-user) and do you provide an automatic fallback to quantized variants when GPU capacity is constrained?
3) SDK preference: our frontend team will want the TypeScript flow for the structured output tool-calling demo. Backend team prefers Python for batch embedding jobs.

We can confirm IP ranges by EOD Wed. Also — a short note from security: they want to see audit log examples for token usage and a short description of key management (KMS/HSM).

Happy to take the May 4 smoke run. Can you do 10:00–11:00 PT?

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Senior Platform Engineer — Integrations
Novus Health
alex.rivera@novushealth.com

Attachment: saml-metadata.xml (xml)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novushealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T13:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dev sync: SDK env & auth/routing smoke run — coordination plan

Alex / team — looping in Karthik for the auth/routing implementation details. Quick internal plan and what we'll push to you tomorrow: 

Deliverables (Redwood -> Novus, expected by Thu EOD)
- Private GitHub repo: sdk-quickstart (two folders: python/ and ts/) with runnable examples, Dockerfile for local runs, and a smoke_test.sh script. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-quickstart (private).
- README sections: SAML mapping steps, OAuth2 client-credentials sample, and a short KMS notes doc for key management.
- Embeddings adapters: example adapter for Milvus (python) and notes on how to swap to Redwood-hosted vector store.
- Routing sample: a JSON policy example showing per-route and per-model fallback config plus TTL for caching.
- Minimal reranker demo that uses embeddings + simple cosine scorer (TS demo).

Proposed runbook for May 4, 10:00–11:00 PT
00–10 min: quick architecture overview and goals (Jonas)
10–35 min: guided smoke run — python quickstart (local) + milestone checks (auth, embeddings write, model call)
35–50 min: TS demo for structured output + tool calling + rerank flow
50–60 min: open issues, next actions (security checklist, procurement steps)

Attachments: runbook-redwood-quickstart.tar.gz (contains smoke test checklist + sample env files)

Questions for Novus before the run
- Confirm Milvus endpoint + credentials for staging (we will use a mocked adapter if you prefer not to share creds).
- Confirm whether security wants real audit logs (we can redaction-sanitize for staging).

@Karthik: can you prepare the Milvus adapter example (Python) and the TS reranker sample?

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dev sync: SDK env & auth/routing smoke run — confirmation and deliverables

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the SAML metadata. 10:00–11:00 PT on May 4 works for us — I’ve penciled it in. Confirming the deliverables Redwood will share prior to the run: 

- Private repo with python/ and ts/ quickstart examples (README, Dockerfile, smoke_test.sh)
- Milvus adapter example (python) + instructions to swap to Redwood vector store
- Routing policy examples demonstrating per-route fallback + model variant selection
- Short doc: audit log examples (token usage) and KMS overview for your security team
- TS demo for structured output + simple reranker sample

We will not require real production creds for the smoke run — please either provide a staging Milvus endpoint or let us know if you want us to use a mocked adapter. If you can confirm IP ranges and give Priya Shah's preferred contact time for a short security review, we'll include that in the pre-read.

I'll send the private repo invite and the runbook link by tomorrow morning. Looking forward to the run.

Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
